bullets_en: Congress cites US midterm results to slam ‘One Nation, One Election’.
Cyclone Murasu triggers heavy rain, cuts off villages in erstwhile Khammam district.
DMK chief Stalin visits Periyar Arivulagam in Coimbatore.
Seoul court upholds ex-President Yoon’s election conviction.
Kerala govt sanctions VACB probe against CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
